messages:
michelle: Quick ask from Atlas pilot: they want an "Optimize Advisor" alpha they can actually use. Must-haves: route-level batch size suggestion, simple cache prefix + TTL hints, and a small set of quant profiles. Bonus: eval-driven regression alerts. Can we scope an alpha we can ship in ~4 weeks?

ramey: My preference is to treat this as configuration advisor only for alpha (no automatic server-side changes). Ship recommendations in Console + API / CLI export.

jules: For batching we can compute a recommended batch size and a suggested max concurrency per route. Implementation: sample N requests (N=10k) -> compute token length percentiles -> choose batch target to maximize tokens-per-batch while keeping queuing latency < X ms. We can expose percentile choices: p50/p75/p95.

michelle: Acceptance criteria idea: pilot orgs should see >=8% token-cost savings on median routes and p99 latency increase <=7%. If alerts detect a regression post-rollout (any new model), they should fire within 12 hours.

tara: Cache hints: provide candidate prefixes (first 32 tokens, or identified fixed headers) and TTL buckets (30s/5m/1h). For alpha we won't run a full simulator; we'll give an estimated hit-rate based on sampled repetition rates in logs. Provide a CLI helper: `ri optimize estimate-cache --logs sample.ndjson`.

vishal: Quant profiles: ship three named presets: `speed`, `balanced`, `precise`. Docs map these to model classes (e.g., Llama-ish, OPT-ish) but we don't auto-map per-model yet. Advise A/B testing + pin model versions.

design-bot: mockups queued: advisor panel (right rail) + modal for "run estimation". I'll drop initial frames by Thu.

jules: Eval alerts: MVP monitor object stores (eval_set_id, route_id, metric_name, threshold, lookback). Eval runner posts metrics to `/api/evals/results`. Monitor compares and emits `regression.alert` events to webhooks + Console inbox + slack channel. RBAC: only org-admins can create monitors for alpha.

ramey: Metric choices: perplexity, exact_match, custom scalar. We should also allow a relative delta mode (e.g., -5% vs baseline) to avoid absolute thresholds.

michelle: Risk notes: bad quant suggestions could break quality; docs must warn and give rollback steps. Also must ensure no PII is sent to advisor service -- all sampling is local or redacted.

vishal: Minimal telemetry: record which recs were shown and which were applied (if the CLI/export was used). Opt-out default for orgs.

product-bot: checklist reminder: feature-flag `optimize-advisor-alpha`, add telemetry event types `advisor.view` + `advisor.apply`, ensure opt-out setting available.

michelle: Proposed owners + rough estimates:
- Frontend advisor panel + modal: jules (1.5w)
- Backend sampling + recommendation service (read-only): ramey (2w)
- Eval-monitor plumbing + webhook integration: tara (1.5w)
- CLI estimator + quickstart: vishal (1w)
- Docs + pilot onboarding: michelle (0.5w)
Total: ~6.5 dev-weeks, aim for 4 sprint cadence (4 weeks). Reduce scope if needed.

jules: To shrink scope: remove percentile toggles and only ship single "recommended" batch size, defer TTL bucket UI (return strings in CLI only).

michelle: OK alpha scope locked: recommendations-only advisor (Console + API + CLI estimator), eval-monitor alpha (admins-only), three quant presets, docs + quickstart. Pilot targets: Atlas + BetaCo + internal dogfood.

ramey: I'll push an RFC for the recommendation schema today. Sample response shape (HTTP):
```
{
  "route": "/predict",
  "batch_recommendation": {"size": "16", "rationale": "80th pct token load"},
  "cache_recommendations": [{"prefix_hint":"first-16","ttl":"5m","est_hit_rate":"12%"}],
  "quant_profile":"balanced"
}
```

michelle: Perfect. Action items:
- design-bot: drop frames Thu -> #design-review
- ramey: RFC + backend stub by Tue -> PR branch `optimize-advisor-alpha`
- tara: PoC eval monitor + sample webhook by Fri
- vishal: CLI estimator v0 by next Wed
- michelle: pilot invite emails + onboarding doc by Mon next week

product-bot: Please open a Jira epic `OPTIMIZE-ADVISOR-ALPHA` and add tickets for frontend/backend/eval-cli/docs.

michelle: Thx all. Filing the epic now and will link this thread. :rocket:

jules: lgtm

vishal: +1

product-bot: note: alpha flagged rollout only. Ensure pilot orgs are enrolled via feature flag.
